text.offer: Yes, I have need of a courier. Duke Akardius is due a certain percentage of profits from my business. Please take this tithe of shillings to him quickly. I am too busy to do it myself. Be warned that any thievery will be reported. I have arranged for the Duke to pay you for your troubles.
text.complete: Ah, I see the banker of Tos is on time this week. Thank you for your swiftness and honor. They could use you around more often.
